name: Tatsumi Misora
source:
Second-year student. A friend of Ruka, serves as the vide president of the Film Club.

An extreme gamer with deep knowledge of smartphone functions. She uses her expertise to work as the club's camerawoman and sound technician.

She has a perpetually listless, downer vibe and speaks in a flat tone, but she isn't cold; in fact, she possesses a deeply compassionate side.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/recrankin/]official website[/url]]
